title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - D-17
notes:
West leads the ♠Q against 2♥. South must lose a trick to the ♥A, but with only 4 side suit losers (1 in spades, 2 in diamonds, and 1 in clubs) the contract looks secure. West's 1♠ overcall warns South that the defense may be in a position to defeat the contract by winning a trick with a spade ruff.

If South makes the mistake of winning the first trick with the ♠K, the contract will fail. South continues by driving out West's ♥A, but West will continue spades and East will ruff dummy's ♠A (it would not help declarer to duck this trick in dummy). South will be left with 4 inescapable losers (1 spade, 2 diamonds, and 1 club).

This danger can be avoided by winning dummy's ♠A at trick 1. A heart is played to drive out West's ♥A and West will play a second round of spades. If East ruffs this trick he will be ruffing South's spade loser. There is no quick entry to the West hand for East to get another spade ruff, and the contract will be secure. South can win any return and draw trump to lose only 3 minor suit tricks at the end.

If instead East chooses to discard on the second round of spades, the result will be the same. South will win the ♠K and draw the rest of the trump. South will still have to lose the spade trick he was budgeting for (along with 2 diamond tricks and a club trick), but the contract will be made.
